description: This file defines a utility class CartMapper that provides static methods to convert Cart and CartItem domain objects into their corresponding response DTOs, CartResponse and CartItemResponse, for API output in a shopping cart service.

classes.name: CartMapper
classes.description: A utility class with static methods to map Cart domain objects to API response DTOs.

methods.name: toResponse (Cart)
methods.description: Converts a Cart object into a CartResponse DTO, sorting items by creation date.

methods.name: toResponse (CartItem)
methods.description: Converts a CartItem object into a CartItemResponse DTO.
